text: Coprolalia [Gr. koproV , filth, + lalia , speech]: Ger. Koprolalie ; Fr. coprolalie ; Ital. coprolalia . The involuntary, and perhaps unconscious, use of obscene words, occurring as a symptom of mental disorder in hysteria and other diseases; it seems to be of the nature of a spasm or tic. Cf. HYSTERIA. ( J.J. )
